verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents connector syncs that pull data into the warehouse from third-party sources via Airbyte-compatible connectors, claiming 300+ sources including Google Analytics and Stripe. Those syncs run as managed Kubernetes CronJobs with failure and recovery alerts, and Segment can also forward data to Jitsu via a webhook. A community user confirms most major ad sources exist but reports a higher setup bar than Segment. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the connector catalog and per-source configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration that syncs work smoothly.
